claim.statement: The 0.146.0 release reports fixes for applying configured proxies across authentication, plugin downloads, MCP authentication, remote execution, WebSockets, redirects and LM Studio paths.

source.title: OpenAI Codex 0.146.0 release
source.locator: Bug fixes: configured proxy routing across networked paths

limitations: A release-note fix does not prove a proxy was configured or that every subprocess and protocol is covered.
Each named path retains its own authentication, destination and side-effect boundary.
unknowns: The effective proxy configuration, rules, DNS handling, destinations and enforcement completeness are unknown.
